name: NY-16
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent George Latimer running for reelection
Republican challenger has reported no fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Latimer holds a D+18 district with incumbency advantages, while his Republican opponent has shown no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets price this at roughly 97% Democratic, consistent with the fundamentals-based expectation of a wide margin.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race, or significant outside spending against Latimer, would warrant moving this toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
NY-16 is a heavily Democratic Westchester-area seat where first-term incumbent George Latimer is seeking reelection. The district's D+18 partisan lean, combined with incumbency and Latimer's fundraising head start, gives Democrats a strong structural advantage. His Republican challenger, Joseph Cinquemani, has reported no fundraising and has no visible outside support.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win at about 97%. The expected margin is roughly 24 points, with meaningful uncertainty given the absence of polling.
